notes.evm_version: Plan called for `paris`, but solc 0.8.10 predates Paris and does not accept that flag. Aave V3 contracts were compiled with the default (`london`) at this solc version. `london` is what ships on mainnet and is what revm executes; zero impact on the pure arithmetic tested here.
notes.calculateLinearInterestAt: The wrapper exposes a 3-arg pure variant of MathUtils.calculateLinearInterest. Upstream is `view` (reads block.timestamp); the wrapper takes `currentTimestamp` explicitly so the revm test is deterministic without env-pinning.
